hero_sub: A messenger that belongs to you
hero_desc:
Chats, groups and channels, end-to-end encrypted calls, an AI assistant
and in-app coins. For Android and Linux. No ads, no tracking.
f1_desc: Text, photos, video, documents and voice messages with captions. Replies, forwarding, reactions and delivery status.
f2_desc: Built-in AI chat powered by advanced language models, available anytime.
f3_desc: Audio and video calls over WebRTC — no intermediaries.
f4_desc: Groups and channels with roles, comments, reactions and paid subscriptions. Live streams play inside the app.
f5_desc: Calls are end-to-end encrypted by WebRTC — their content is not available to the server. For messages, end-to-end encryption is planned and does not exist yet.
f6_desc: An in-app currency for premium, sticker packs and paid channels. Transfers between users included.

faq.a: A messenger for Android and Linux: chats, groups, channels with comments and streams, encrypted calls, a built-in AI assistant and in-app coins. No ads and no tracking.
Yes. The full messenger is free. Premium — no ads, extended storage — costs 500 EION per month or 4200 EION per year, paid with in-app coins.

Calls are end-to-end encrypted by WebRTC, and their content is not available to the server. Messages travel over a secure channel but are stored on the server in plain form — end-to-end encryption for them is planned and does not exist yet. We prefer to say this plainly.

An internal currency of the app: premium, sticker packs, paid channel subscriptions and transfers between users. You get 50 coins on registration. They are not money or cryptocurrency and cannot be exchanged for money.
Android and Linux — both available now as a beta. iOS and Windows are planned.

dl_note: Android will ask for permission to install an app from an unknown source — that is normal outside Google Play. On Linux, make the file executable and run it.
notify_title: Get one email when EION arrives in the store
tok_plan_text: A long-term goal is to take EION coins beyond the app — as a token on Solana. That work has not started, and no dates are promised.
tok_disclaimer: Today EION coins are an internal accounting unit of the service. They are not money, securities or cryptocurrency, cannot be exchanged for money, and this page is not an offer to invest.
cookie_text: We use Google Analytics to count visits to this site. The app itself contains no analytics.
